processes.routing_decision_20261015: Operator decision 2026-10-15 (verbatim): "in terms of n8n, then, we should try OAuth first. And if OAuth fails or if the answer needs higher reasoning, then we go to DeepSeek." Routing: grok OAuth -> chatgpt OAuth -> deepseek FAST (llm_routing_policy route_profile n8n_oauth_first); an OAuth lane not enabled on the host (CIO_BRIDGE_OAUTH_TRANSPORTS) is skipped; an empty/invalid OAuth answer falls through to the next lane; reasoning_tier high puts the routing row's reasoning_lane (DeepSeek PRO_THINK) first. The routing row is read only by cio_governed_model_bridge, so the cron line's in-process path is unchanged.
